TSV to JSON

Convert tab-separated values to JSON — header-row option, proper quoted-field parsing.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your TSV data.
  2. Toggle whether the first row holds headers.
  3. The JSON converts live.
  4. Copy it or download as data.json.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are tabs inside fields handled?

Fields wrapped in double quotes may contain tabs and newlines; "" is an escaped quote.

What if there is no header row?

Untick the option and you get a JSON array of arrays instead of objects.

Are duplicate headers handled?

Duplicate header names get a numeric suffix (name, name_2) so no data is lost.

Is empty input an error?

No — empty input simply clears the output.
